game.modules.tome.data.chats.point_zero_: @playername@, nice to see you again! Or is this the first time that you have seen me?
Yes, this is our first meeting.

Ah, for you perhaps, but not for me.
Listen, someday you will encounter me again but it will not be me you see now. It will be younger me, if you will.
This is very important: do not tell my previous me about me. Understood?
game.modules.tome.data.chats.pre_charred:
@playername@, I am one of a party of Sun Paladins sent by Aeryn. We arrived here tracking the orcs.
They have gone through the portal, and a few of my friends were pulled in with them.
We captured an orc earlier.  He revealed that the staff you seek is to be used to absorb the power of a remote place for dark rituals.
You must traverse this portal, if you have any means to, and stop the orcs.
I think I can use the portal. Do not worry!

One of our patrols noticed some strange orc movements around the southern part of the continent, in the desert of Erúan.
A group of orcs were guarding something that looked like the staff you asked about.
You should go there to investigate. This might be your only chance.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.ring_of_blo:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a small humanoid creature with a disproportionate head.*#WHITE#
Ah, what have we here? @playerdescriptor.race@, I believe you have turned at the wrong corner.
So it would seem. What is going on here?

This is my Ring of Blood! Listen, you have now two choices.
Since you do not look like slave fodder to me I will offer to let you pay to play the game.
If you feel you cannot take part in a slaver's game, I am afraid you will need to... disappear.
Slavers? This is so wrong! [attack]
You think so? Die.
Game? I like playing, what's this about?

Well, you see, it's quite simple. I will mentally take control of various wild creatures or slaves while you use the orb of command on the other side of this room to take control of a slave.
Then we fight using our pawns for 10 rounds. If your slave survives you will win the Bloodcaller.
What if I lose?
Blood, death without self-harm risks? Great fun!
Blood, death without self-harm risks? Great fun!
Normally you would be taken as a slave, but you look like you would be more useful as a full-time player, so you can just try again.

Superb. Oh yes, before I forget, to use the orb you will need to pay the standard fee of 150 gold pieces.
I'm sure this is small money to an adventurer of your class.
150 gold? Err... yes, sure.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*You place your hands on the orb.*#WHITE#
You must provide 150 gold to take part in the fight.
[Pay 150 gold]
Let the fight start!
Bring it on!

So, you tasted blood? Liked it? I am sure you did; you are just that kind of people.
Anyway, I suppose you deserve your reward.
You can always participate again for fun, if you've got the gold to spare.
Thanks, it was fun!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a cute little orange cat. It looks hungry and looks at you.*#WHITE#
Meowww?

#LIGHT_GREEN#*It rubs up against your leg and purrs.*#WHITE#
Rrrrrrrrrrrr.
Hey maybe you would like some of this delicious lookin troll intestines? #LIGHT_GREEN#[Feed him the intestines]#WHITE#
Sorry little fellow, I can't help you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It eats it all and looks happy. After a while it strolls away. Somehow you feel you have not seen the last of it.*#WHITE#
game.modules.tome.data.chats.shadow_cryp: No time to talk fellow Wayist! ATTACK! FOR THE WAY!
The foolish cultist that created me is no more. What am I to do now...
You are me, come with me!
You should head back to Irkkk.
I fear that would get confusing very fast. I think I will go back to Irkkk. Farewell my clone!
Clone? No you are the clone.
Clone? No you are the clone.
Sure... if you prefer to think about it this way. We are all part of The Way anyway.
I think so too, farewell my clone.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.shertul_for:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature slowly turns to you. You hear its terrible voice directly in your head.#WHITE#*
Welcome, master.
What are you, and what is this place?
Master? I am not your mas...
Why do I understand you? The texts are unreadable to me.
What can I do here?
What else can this place do?
Would it be possible to improve my Cloak of Deception so I do not need to wear it to pass as a living being?
You asked me to come, about a farportal?
You asked me to come, about the rod of recall?
Would it be possible for my Transmogrification Chest to automatically extract gems?
Are there any training facilities?
Can you use your magic to alter the appearance of my gear?
I find your appearance unsettling. Any way you can change it?
I have come upon a strange thing indeed. #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell him about Melinda]

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You possess a control rod. You are the master.
Err... ok.
Err... ok.

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master; you have the rod. I am created to speak to the master.

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you with intensity. You 'see' images in your head.
You see titanic wars in an age now forgotten. You see armies of what you suppose are Sher'Tuls since they look like the shadow.
They fight with weapons, magic and other things. They fight gods. They hunt them down, killing or banishing them.
You see great fortresses like this one, flying all over the skies of Eyal - shining bastions of power glittering in the young sun.
You see the gods beaten, defeated and dead. All but one.
Then you see darkness; it seems like the shadow does not know what followed those events.

You shake your head as the vision dissipates, and your normal sight comes back slowly.
#WHITE#*
Those are Sher'Tuls? They fought the gods?!
They had to. They forged terrible weapons of war. They won.
But then where are they now if they won?
They are gone now. I cannot tell you more.
But I am the master!
Fine.

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master. You can use this place as you desire. However, most of the energies are depleted and only some rooms are usable.
To the south you will find the storage room.

This Fortress is designed as a mobile base for the Godslayers - it can fly.
It is also equiped with various facilities: exploratory farportal, emergency containment field, remote storage, ...
However, the Fortress is badly damaged and has lain dormant for too long. Its energies are nearly depleted.
Take this Transmogrification Chest. It is linked by a permanent farportal to the Fortress. Any item you put inside will be sent to the power core and dismantled for energy.
There are, however, unwanted byproducts to this operation: the generation of a metal known as gold. It is of no use to the Fortress and thus will be sent back to you.
I will, thanks.
I have already found such a chest in my travel. Will it work?

Yes, it will. I will attune it to this fortress.
Done.

Long ago the Sher'tuls used farportals not only for transportation to known locations, but also to explore new parts of the world, or even other worlds.
This Fortress is equipped with an exploratory farportal, and now has enough energy to allow one teleportation. Each teleportation will take you to a random part of the universe and use 45 energy.
Beware that the return portal may not be nearby your arrival point; you will need to find it. You can use the rod of recall to try to force an emergency recall, but it has high chances of breaking the exploratory farportal forever.
You may use the farportal; however, beware - I sense a strange presence in the farportal room.
I will check it out, thanks.

The rod of recall you possess is not a Sher'tul artifact, but it is based on Sher'tul design.
The Fortress now has enough energy to upgrade it. It can be changed to recall you to the Fortress.
I like it the way it is now. Thanks anyway.
That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.

Yes master, a training facility is available to the north, but it is not yet powered on.
I will need to use 50 energy to do this.
Maybe later.
Maybe later.

Yes master, the Mirror of Reflections is what you need. It is currently dormant but could be re-activated.
I will need to use 10 energy to do this.
#{italic}##CRIMSON#This feature is purely cosmetic is available only to donators/buyers. You can unlock the room and use the preview but you will not be able to validate your choices.#{normal}#
That could be quite nice. Yes, please do it.

Ah yes, you seem to master the simple art of alchemy. I can change the chest to automatically use your power to extract a gem if the transmogrification of the gem would reward more energy.
However, I will need to use 25 energy to do this.
Maybe sometime later.
I can alter the Fortress holographic projection matrix to accomodate your racial tastes. This will require 60 energy, however.
Can you try for a human female appearance please?
Can you try for a human male appearance please?
Please revert to your default appearance.
Well, you do not look so bad actually. Let it be for now.

Yes Master. I can use 10 energy to infuse your cloak. When you take it off the effect should still persist.
However, I suggest you still carry it with you in case something manages to remove it from you.
Not now.

Demonic taint. Yes I have a way to help in the archives. However this is a long process, the subject will need to live here for a while.
She will have to spend 8 hours per day in the regeneration tank.
This is great news! I will tell her at once.

"You should not be here. How di-"#{normal}# It stops abruptly, and its attention seems to turn to the staff in your hands. #{italic}#"How did you get that?! You fool, you do not know what forces you play with! Get it away from here - BEGONE!"
"You should not be here. How did you get here?! BEGONE!"

#{italic}#As you open the door you stare in amazement at what is beyond. A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!

But your wonder is cut short as the Sher'Tul notices you, and you feel its intense concentration bear down on you like an unstoppable force. A voice in your head booms, #{normal}#%s#{italic}#

A wave of mental and magical power blasts into you with the might of a falling star. You are lifted into the air, and intense pressure bears down on every inch of your skin, threatening to crush you into nothingness. You try to resist for a moment, until--#{normal}#
[continue]

#{italic}#You wake up suddenly next to your farportal with a pounding headache. Your cheeks feel wet, and touching them you see your fingers stained red - you have been crying tears of blood. A dark and terrible memory lurks at the back of your mind, but the more you try to remember it the harder it becomes, and slowly it fades completely, like a dream.#{normal}#
[done]
*#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb seems to represent the world of Eyal as a whole. It is also probably used for controlling the fortress.

You do not understand the inscriptions there.#WHITE#*
#{italic}#"Rokzan krilt copru."#{normal}#
#WHITE#*#{italic}#"Insert control rod."#{normal}#
[Examine the orb]
[Fly the fortress -- #LIGHT_RED#FOR TESTING ONLY#LAST#]
[Begin the Lichform ceremory]

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The device seems to be made of pure crystal. It projects a very accurate map of the known world - including the forbidden continent of the south.
There seems to be a hole about the size and form of your Rod of Recall.#WHITE#*
[Insert the rod]

*#LIGHT_GREEN#As you take the rod close to the orb it seems to vibrate and react.
A shadow appears in a corner of the room! You retract the rod immediately but the shadow stays.
It looks like the horrors you fought when coming inside, only less degenerated.
The thing looks roughly humanoid, but it has no head and its limbs look like tentacles. It does not seem hostile.#WHITE#*
*#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb is used to control the gladium arena.#WHITE#*
[Go back to the Fortress]
[Alter the appearance of %s]
[Alter the appearance of your body]
[Alter the appearance of your facial features]
[Alter the appearance of your hair]
[Alter the appearance of your cosmetic aura]
[Load/Save outfit]
[Disable the visual effects of your sustains]
[Leave the mirror alone]
*#LIGHT_GREEN#As you gaze into the mirror you see an infinite number of slightly different reflections of yourself. You feel dizzy.#WHITE#*
All resistances
Armour Hardiness
Armour
From 0 to 1000
*#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb is used to control the training facilities.#WHITE#*
[Create one target dummy]
[Create two target dummy]
[Create three target dummy]
[Create five target dummy]
[Create ten target dummy]
[Change dummies armour]
[Change dummies resistances]
[Reset]
game.modules.tome.data.chats.slasul.chat:
What is this? Why have you entered my temple and slain my followers?
Speak or die, for I am Slasul and you shall not disrupt my plans.
So be it... Die now!
I was sent by Ukllmswwik to stop your mad schemes to control all underwater life!

I see. So the dragon sent you. He told you I am insane, I assume?
But which of us is truly evil? Myself, working to better my people, doing no harm to anyone, or you, who comes here to kill me, destroying my friends and planning to do the same to me?
Who is the insane one?
Your feeble attempt to sway me from the side of good will not work. Pay for you sins!
If you refuse to see reason, you leave me no choice!
Your words are... disturbing. Why should I spare you?

Spare me?#LIGHT_GREEN#*He laughs.*#WHITE#
Do not be so hasty to assume YOU are in a position to offer mercy to ME!
Yet I shall tell you my story. You surface dwellers do not know much about nagas, but let me tell you this: our current condition was not our choice.
When Nalore sank, many of us died, so we resorted to using the magic of this temple. It worked, it saved us, and yet we are cursed. Cursed in this form by the terrible magic.
If you do not believe anything else of what I say, please believe at least this: the Sher'Tul are hiding, not gone, and they are not benevolent entities.
Recently, that water dragon that sent you here started sending "agents" to secure the temple. I can only imagine his goals, but they are clearly not peaceful.
You do not sound mad to me... could Ukllmswwik have lied?
I will not be deceived by your lies! I will make your pay for your victims!
As you wish. It did not have to come to this...
Use this portal. It will bring you back to his cave; ask him the truth.
I will make him pay for his treachery.
Thank you for listening to me.
The dragon was lying, I can feel it. I have decided to embrace your cause.
Farewell, Slasul.

I secretly hoped you would.
Then let us seal this alliance. Share your lifeforce with me! So long you should live I shall not be killed!
In return let me offer you this powerful trident.
I shall accept your offer, my liege.
LET US BE BOUND!
This sounds strange. I need to think about it.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.sorcerer_en:
<<<The two Sorcerers lie dead before you.
Their bodies vanish in a small cloud of mist, quickly fading away.
You feel you the gentle warmth of your Distant Sun patron. It speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#YOU HAVE DONE WELL %s! YOU DESERVE A REWARD!#LAST#
<<<You can feel your mind filling with warmth and desire to serve your patron>>>
#YELLOW#BUT YOU MUST DO ONE MORE TASK!#LAST#
<<<The warmth in your head is getting intense, too intense. You feel your sanity burning away!>>>
#YELLOW#THROW YOURSELF INTO THE PORTAL! OPEN THE WAY FOR MY POWER TO RADIATE OVER YOUR WORLD! #CRIMSON#DO IT!#LAST#
<<<Those last words are compelling. You can not resist!>>>
#YELLOW#[sacrifice yourself to bring forth your patron to Eyal!]
sacrificing %s to bring the fiery wrath of the Distant Sun
sacrificing %s to bring the fiery wrath of the Distant Sun
Nnnnnooo! Get.. get out of my head!

<<<The warmth in your mind turns into searing pain!>>>
#CRIMSON#YOU WILL DO AS YOU ARE TOLD! YOU ARE MY TOOL AND I INTEND TO USE IT!
#LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice yourself to bring forth your patron to Eyal!]
#LIGHT_GREEN#[In a last incredible display of willpower you fight the Distant Sun for a few seconds, letting you project your thoughts to Aeryn.]#WHITE# High Lady! Kill me #{bold}#NOW#{normal}#
#LIGHT_GREEN#[In a last incredible display of willpower you fight the Distant Sun for a few seconds, unsure how to stop it.]#WHITE##{bold}#NO!#{normal}#

<<<Through your mind Aeryn sees what the Distant Sun is planning.>>>
You were a precious ally and a friend. The world will remember your last act of selfless sacrifice. I swear it.
<<<As she says this she pierces your body with a mighty thrust of her sword, ending the plans of your mad patron.>>>
#LIGHT_GREEN#[slip peacefully into death.]
#LIGHT_GREEN#[slip peacefully into death.]
sacrificing %s to stop the mad sun's plans

<<<The precious seconds fly by, but as you feel your mind breaking and burning you see a strange figure appearing in front of you, it radiates of immense power.>>>
<<<The strange, amorphous figure in front of you remains completely silent. With a gesture of one of its tendrils, the staff is ripped from your hands. A surge of energy goes through the room as it grips the staff. Then you remember the old myth of the Godslayers. This is none other than a ***Sher'Tul***#{italic}#, and it knows you have been colluding with a god. That alone tells you everything you need to know.>>>
#CRIMSON#[Your mind is burnt by your patron sun! Fight for your sun god now!]

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two Sorcerers lie dead before you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Their bodies vanish in a small cloud of mist, quickly fading away.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You feel the Way reaching out to you, the whole yeek race speaks to you.*#WHITE#
You have done something incredible %s! You also have created a unique opportunity for the yeek race!
The energies of those farportals are incredible, using them we could make the Way radiate all over Eyal, forcing it down on the other races, bringing them the same peace and happiness we feel in the Way.
You must go through the farportal and willingly sacrifice yourself inside. Your mind will embed itself into the farportal network, spreading the Way far and wide!
Even though you will die you will bring the world, and the yeeks, ultimate peace.
The Way will never forget you. Now go and make history!
sister
brother
#LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice yourself to bring the Way to every sentient creature.]
#LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice yourself to bring the Way to every sentient creature.]
sacrificing %s to bring the Way to all
sacrificing %s to bring the Way to all
But... I did so much, I could do so much more for the Way by staying alive!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*You feel the Way taking over your mind, your body.*#WHITE#
You will do as asked, for the good of all Yeeks! The Way is always right.
#LIGHT_GREEN#[In a last incredible display of willpower you fight the Way for a few seconds, letting you project your thoughts to Aeryn.]#WHITE# High Lady! Kill me #{bold}#NOW#{normal}#

#LIGHT_GREEN#*Through your mind Aeryn sees what the Way is planning.*#WHITE#
You were a precious ally and a friend. The world will remember your last act of selfless sacrifice. I swear it.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As she says this she pierces your body with a mighty thrust of her sword, ending the plans of the Way.*#WHITE#
sacrificing %s to stop the Way

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two Sorcerers lie dead before you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Their bodies vanish in a small cloud of mist, quickly fading away.*#WHITE#
But the portal to the Void is already open. It must be closed before the Creator can come through or all will have been in vain!
After searching the remains of the Sorcerers you find a note explaining that the portal can only be closed with a sentient being's sacrifice.
Aeryn, I am sorry but one of us needs to be sacrificed for the world to go on. #LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice Aeryn for the sake of the world]
I will close it. #LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice yourself for the sake of the world]
sacrificing %s for the sake of the world

I cannot believe we succeeded. I was prepared to die and it seems I will die, but at least I will do so knowing my sacrifice is not in vain.
Please, make sure the world is safe.
You will never be forgotten.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two Sorcerers lie dead before you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Their bodies vanish in some immaterial mist.*#WHITE#
You have won the game!
Both Maj'Eyal and the Far East are safe from the dark schemes of the Sorcerers and their God.
Aeryn, are you well?

I cannot believe we succeeded. I was prepared to die and yet I live.
I might have underestimated you. You did more than we could have hoped for!
We both did.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.sorcerer_fi: High Sun Paladin Aeryn appears next to you!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two Sorcerers stands before you, shining like the Sun.*#WHITE#
Ah! Our guest is finally here. I take it you found the peak entertaining?
Spare me the small talk. I am here to stop you!
Why are you doing all that? You were supposed to help people!

Oh, but all we want is to help people. We have come to the self-evident conclusion that common people are just unfit to govern themselves, always bickering, arguing...
Since the last invasion of the orcs there has been no threat to unite them!
So you have decided to become the threat yourselves?
Us? Ah, no, we are merely instruments for the Master. We have planned for His return.

The Creator. The God who made this world, He who watched silently as the races fought and burnt the land.
He who felt great sorrow for this world. He who shall now shatter the barriers of this world to remake it, only better!
The staff has allowed us to drain enough energy from this world to open the portal to the Void and summon Him through!
It is already too late. He is coming through as we speak -- it is only a matter of hours!
I *WILL* stop you! The world will not end today!

The Creator. The God who made this world, He who watched silently as the races fought and burnt the land.
He who felt great sorrow for this world. He who shall now shatter the barriers of this world to remake it, only better!
The staff will allow us to drain enough energy from this world to open the portal to the Void and summon Him through!
You cannot stop us now!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The air whirls at your side and suddenly High Sun Paladin Aeryn appears!*#WHITE#
Then you shall not fight alone! Together we shall stop them, or die trying!
I am glad to have you at my side, my Lady. Let's hunt some wizards!
game.modules.tome.data.chats.tannen.chat: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Nobody answers.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Nobody answers. Tannen is probably still busy studying the orb.*#WHITE#
How may I be of service, good @playerdescriptor.race@?
[Relate to him the story of the staff and the Orb of Many Ways and the portals.]
I have the diamond and the athame. [Hand over the Athame and Diamond]
Thieving, murderous wretch. Prepare to die!
How fares your research? Are we ready to create the portal?
Astonishing! I have heard tell of this Orb in ancient texts and legends. Might I see it?
[Show him the Orb of Many Ways]
Truly, it is the work of a great master. Perhaps Linaniil herself had a hand in its making. And you say you come bearing instructions in its usage?
I do. [Show him Zemekkys's scribbled notes]

#LIGHT_GREEN#*He spends a few minutes reading*#WHITE# Ah! I see. I did not at first grasp this Zemekkys's methods, but I see now that they are sound, and it is simply his penmanship that needs improvement. We can manage to reproduce his work here, but, as he says, we will need the Blood-Runed Athame and a Resonating Diamond.
Have you any idea where they might be found?

If the orcs created a portal in the depths of Reknor, they must have had access to such items. And if these items cannot pass through the portal they created, then it stands to reason that they must still be in Maj'Eyal. I would search Reknor, starting near the portal itself. Perhaps they did not move the Athame and Diamond far after its creation.
I'll get searching. Thank you.

One last thing. I will need to hold onto the Orb of Many Ways while you search. I lack the expertise this Chronomancer Zemekkys possesses, and have much learning on the subject to do if I am to follow in his footsteps.
[Hand him the Orb]
I still require the Orb for now.
Thank you. I will treat it with the utmost care.
Farewell. I'll return with the Athame and Diamond.
Very well. There is no hurry. But I will need to spend a number of days studying it before we can create your portal.
I understand. I'll return with the Athame and Diamond.

Excellent. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields," return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.
Thank you, and farewell.
Thank you, and farewell.
Excellent. Are you yet willing to leave the Orb in my care for a time?
I dare not let it out of my sight. I'm sorry.
Here it is. Guard it carefully. I must return to the Far East soon.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The old man sighs*#WHITE# Very well. I suppose I must make do with a cursory examination under your supervision.
[Hand him the orb]
Thank you. Give me a few minutes. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He begins to pace back and forth absently, staring at the Orb.*#WHITE#

#LIGHT_GREEN#*He stops pacing and returns the Orb to you.*#WHITE# I believe I know most of what I need to. But I need a few details cleared up. You'll have to return to this Elven Chronomancer and ask him whether he meant an inverted probabilistic field or a reverted probabilistic field. I dare not guess, as the result could be quite unpleasant for you.
I'll return with the answer.

Fear not. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields", return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.

I think not, fool. Look down.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You notice you're standing on an etched portal.*#WHITE#
What in the...
What in the...

I am ready. You are not. Look down.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You notice you're standing on an etched portal.*#WHITE#
game.modules.tome.data.chats.tarelion_st:
Yes @playername@, I have heard you plan on going into the wild world, looking for some adventures of your own.
This is good, more of us should get out of here once in a while and actually help people out there.
Say, maybe you might want to get an adventure and help Angolwen?

During the Spellblaze the world was torn apart - literally. A part of it, that we now call the Abashed Expanse, was ripped from the world and thrown into the void between the stars.
We managed to stabilize it and it is now orbiting Eyal. Recently we have noticed a disturbance there; if we do nothing it will crash onto Eyal, bringing much destruction in its wake.
Because it was once part of a land we know well we can teleport you there. You will need to stabilize three wormholes by firing any attack spells at them.
The instability is also to your advantage there, your simple phase door spell will be fully controllable.

So, you think you can help us ?
No sorry, I need to go.
Oh well, farewell on your trips. Now I need to find somebody else to go up there.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.tarelion.ch:
I say, you there. Yes, you, young one!
You seem like the adventuring fare, up to all sorts of doo-daddle in the outside world, I imagine. Well, don't forget to pay patronage to our good library here in the city. The riches of the world are all well and good, but where would we be without the gift of knowledge? And all proceeds go towards the funding of further research. No greater cause, yes?
Uh, yes, of course... I'll be moving on now.
Uh, yes, of course... I'll be moving on now.
Hold on! You... You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!

Why, well-spotted, whippersnapper! Indeed, when the mood takes me I sometimes travel under the guise of an apprentice. It permits me to traverse the land unnoticed in my research, and if I meet any I deem worthy and sympathetic to Angolwen's cause, then so much the better. And it does provide the odd chortle, I tell you!
game.modules.tome.data.chats.temporal_ri:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall man, glowing like a star, appears out of nowhere.*#WHITE#
You destroyed *it* both? I am sorry for my harsh tone when we first met, but repairing time threads is stressful.
I cannot stay. I still have much to do. But take this-- it should help you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He disappears again before you can even reply. A rift opens, to Maj'Eyal... you hope.*#WHITE#

#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall man, glowing like a star, appears out of nowhere.*#WHITE#
Oh no, another *adventurer*! You should not mess with things beyond your comprehension!
Do not meddle in the affairs of Time, for it passes swiftly and is easily disrupted!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He looks at you more closely.*#WHITE#
You seem capable. Help me, fight the abominations while I repair the timeline. It is your only way out!
game.modules.tome.data.chats.the_master_:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Master crumbles before you, vanquished. Yet in the blink of an eye you see his form recreating from dust; unharmed and ready to fight again!*#WHITE#
Ahah you fool! See how even death has no meaning for me; for I am the Master and you are my toy, now and forever.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.trap_primin:
Choose a trap to prepare with a primed (instant) trigger or to dismantle.
#YELLOW#Newly prepared traps are placed on cooldown.#LAST#
game.modules.tome.data.chats.tutorial_st: Hello there. What subject interests you?
Is there nothing more for me to learn here?

You have completed all the tutorials, and should now know the basics of ToME4. You are ready to step forward into the world to find glory, treasures and be mercilessly slaughtered by hordes of creatures you thought you could handle!

During this tutorial some creatures were adjusted according to the needs of the lessons. In the unforgiving world of Eyal, monsters are rarely this nice!

If you need a reminder of which key does what, you can access the game menu by pressing #GOLD#Escape#WHITE# and checking the key binds. You can also adjust them to suit your needs.

If this is your first time with the game, you will find the selection of races and classes limited. Don't worry; many, many more will become available as you unlock them during your adventures. 

Now go boldly and remember: #GOLD#have fun!#WHITE#
Press #GOLD#Escape#WHITE#, then select #GOLD#Save and Exit#WHITE#, and create a new character!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@'s deep voice booms through the caverns.*#WHITE#
This is my domain, and I do not take kindly to intruders. What is your purpose here?
I am here to kill you and take your treasures! Die, damned fish!
DIE!
DIE!
I did not mean to intrude. I shall leave now.

Wait! You seem to be worthy, so let me tell you a story.
During the Age of Pyre the world was sundered by the last effects of the Spellblaze. A part of the continental shelf of Maj'Eyal was torn apart and thrown into the sea.
The Naloren Elves perished... or so the world thinks. Some of them survived; using ancient Sher'Tul magic they had kept for themselves, they transformed to live underwater.
They are now called the nagas. They live deep in the ocean between Maj'Eyal and the Far East.
One of them, Slasul, rebelled against his order and decided he wanted the world for himself, both underwater and above. He found an ancient temple, probably a Sher'Tul remain, called the Temple of Creation.
He believes he can use it to #{italic}#improve#{normal}# nagas.
But he has become mad and now looks upon all other intelligent water life as a threat, and that includes myself.
I cannot leave this sanctuary, but perhaps you could help me?
After all, it would be an act of mercy to end his madness.
I would still rather kill you and take your treasure!
I shall do as you say, but how do I find him?
That seems... unwise. My apologies, but I must refuse.
I can open a portal to his lair, far away in the western sea, but be warned: this is one-way only. I cannot bring you back. You will have to find your own way.
I will.
This is a death trap! Goodbye.
Yes?
TREACHERY!
I want your treasures, water beast!
Oh, is that so? Well, COME GET THEM!
I spoke with Slasul, and he did not seem hostile, or mad.
Farewell, dragon.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ roars!*#WHITE# You listen to the lies of this mad naga!
You are corrupted! TAINTED!
DO NOT MEDDLE IN THE AFFAIRS OF DRAGONS!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Shake your head.*#LAST#He swayed my mind! Please, I am not your enemy.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ calms down!*#WHITE# Very well; he is indeed a trickster.  Now go finish your task, or do not come back!
Thank you, mighty one.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.undead_star:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a Human clothed in black robes. He seems to be ignoring you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You stand inside some kind of summoning circle, which prevents you from moving.*#WHITE#
Oh yes! YES, one more for my collection. My collection, yes. A powerful one indeed!

A powerful tool against my enemies. Yes, yes. They all hate me, but I will show them my power!
I will show them! SHOW THEM!
I am not a tool! RELEASE ME!

You cannot talk. You cannot talk! You are a slave, a tool!
You are mine! Be quiet!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As his mind drifts off you notice part of the summoning circle is fading. You can probably escape!*#WHITE#

#LIGHT_GREEN#*He falls to his knees.*#WHITE#
Please spare me! I am pitiful. I will not stop you. Let me leave!

But, but, you were my... you...
You need me! What do you think you will do on the surface? Everything you will meet will try to destroy you.
You are strong but you cannot resist them all!
ARRGGggg... You are alone! You will be destroyed!
ARRGGggg... You are alone! You will be destroyed!

I can give you a cloak that will conceal your true nature!
With it all people will see when they look at you is a normal average Human. You can go about your business.
Please!
Thanks for the information. Now you may die. [kill him]
game.modules.tome.data.chats.unremarkabl:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A beautiful Elven woman in golden robes stands before you, facing an orc clad in mail.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "Abandon this fight, orc! You cannot win: I stand with the power of the Sun and the shadows of the Moons."
Krogar: "Ha! It's only been one hour and you already look tired, my 'lady'."
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you enter the room they notice you.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "You! @playerdescriptor.race@! Help me defeat this monster or begone!"
Krogar: "Ah, looking for help? Bah. @playerdescriptor.race@, kill this wench for me and I shall reward you!"
Thank you, @playername@. I hate to admit it, but you saved my life.
At your service. But may I ask what you were doing in this dark place?
At your service. I have been gone for months, but I can feel it, at last this is my homeland!

I am an Anorithil, a mage of the Sun and Moons; we fight all that is evil. I was with a group of Sun Paladins; we came from the Gates of Morning to the east.
My companions were... were slaughtered by orcs, and I nearly died as well. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. But may I ask a favor myself? I am not from these lands. I used a farportal guarded by orcs deep below the Iron Throne and was brought here.

Yes, I noticed you were not from here. Your only hope is the Gates of Morning, the last bastion of freedom in this orc territory. When you leave the caves, head southeast; you cannot miss it.
Tell High Sun Paladin Aeryn that you met me. I'll send word to let you pass.
Thank you, I will talk with Aeryn.

Gone? Wait, this face.. you are @playername@! We thought you died in the naga portal explosion!
Thanks to your courage the Gates of Morning still stand.
You should go there at once.
Sadly I am the bringer of bad news, the orcs are planning something. Good luck, my lady.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.yeek_wayist:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a creature about as tall as a Halfling, covered in small white fur and with a disproportionate head.
You also notice he does not wield his greatsword. It seems to float in the air, bound to his will.*#WHITE#
Why did you save me, stranger? You are not of the Way.
Well, you seemed to need help.
So I could rip your throat myself!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The greatsword floats to a less aggressive stance. He seems surprised.*#WHITE#
Then, on behalf of the Way, I thank you.
What is the Way, and what are you?
The Way is enlightenment, peace and protection. I am a Yeek. I came through this tunnel to explore this part of the world that was closed to us for centuries.
Can you tell me more about the Way?
Select the party member to receive the mental shield:
The contact with the Wayist mind has improved your mental shields. (+15 mental save, +10%% confusion resistance)
I am never alone. I have the Way.

I cannot, but I may show you a glimpse.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He leans toward you. Your mind is suddenly filled with feelings of peace and happiness.*#WHITE#
This is the Way.
Thank you for this vision. Farewell, my friend.
Thank the Way. This... thing... would have killed me.
The Way sent me to explore this side of the tunnel.
Yes, me too. We should split up to cover more ground.
Farewell. We are the Way, always.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.zemekkys_do:
What? Ah, it is you, @playername@.
I take it you are satisfied with the portal.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.zemekkys_st:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
I am sorry, but I cannot do that.
game.modules.tome.data.chats.zemekkys.ch:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A slot in the door opens and a pair of wild eyes peer out.*#WHITE#
What do you want, @playerdescriptor.race@?
Paladin Aeryn told me that you could help me. I need to get to Maj'Eyal.
I found the Blood-Runed Athame, but there was no Resonating Diamond.
I have a Resonating Diamond.

Pfaugh! Her goal in life is to waste my time! Maj'Eyal? Why not Narnia or Chicago? Just as easy to send you someplace entirely fictional as Maj'Eyal. Go away.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot slams shut.*#WHITE#
I got here from Maj'Eyal, didn't I? I have this magic Orb I looted from a dead orc, see, and...

#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot opens.*#WHITE#
Orb, you say? That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal? Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways! It's been lost for ages!
[Hold up the orb]

#LIGHT_GREEN#*His eyes widen.*#WHITE#
Great Socks of Aeryn! It IS the Orb! Maybe we can get you home after all. Or maybe we can get you embedded in magma a thousand leagues straight down.
May I come in?

You think I'm letting some filthy @playerdescriptor.race@ in my house with the Orb of Many Ways?
I blow myself up quite enough already without that thing in the house, thank you.
Besides, I still can't help you unless you have a Blood-Runed Athame to etch a portal.
Err, and that portal must be etched on a piece of prepared Resonating Marble.
The Gates of the Morning has a slab of Marble that once could have served, but a number of, um, incidents have taken their toll.
It'll require a Resonating Diamond to get it properly prepared. Oh, and I want 100 gold.
Where can I find all that?

Try your purse for the 100 gold. As for an Athame and a Resonating Diamond, I assume the orcs have some if they're cooking up portals to use that Orb on. Try the Vor Armory. It so happens that I know a back way in. Never mind why.
Of course there was no Resonating Diamond. What makes you think Briagh would let one loose for even a second?
Briagh?

Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
Where might I find Briagh's lair??
Well south of the Sunwall. I'll mark it for you on your map.
I'll be back with a Resonating Diamond.
Yes? You got the Athame, the gem and 100 gold?
[Give him the gem, the athame and 100 gold]
Sorry, it seems I lack some stuff. I will be back.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The door opens and a shabby Elf emerges.*#WHITE#
Off we go to prepare the portal!
[follow him]
game.modules.tome.data.chats.zigur_minds: I am looking for mindstar training.

I can teach you mindstar mastery (talent category Wild-gift/Mindstar mastery).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive training to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you some additional skills for 750 gold.
The shopkeeper spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of channeling energy through mindstars.
He is impressed with your affinity for natural forces.
Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - 500 gold.

game.modules.tome.data.chats.zigur_train:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A grim-looking Fighter stands there, clad in mail armour and a large olive cloak. He doesn't appear hostile - his sword is sheathed.*#WHITE#
%s, our guild has been watching you and we believe that you have potential.
We see that the hermetic arts have always been at the root of each and every trial this land has endured, and we also see that one day they will bring about our destruction. So we have decided to take action by calling upon Nature to help us combat those who wield the arcane.
We can train you, but you need to prove you are pure, untouched by the eldritch forces, and ready to fight them to the end.
You will be challenged against magical foes. Should you defeat them, we will teach you our ways, and never again will you be able to be tainted by magic, or use it.

#LIGHT_RED#Note:  Completing this quest will forever prevent this character from using spells or items powered by arcane forces.  In exchange you'll be given access to a mindpower based generic talent tree, Anti-magic, and be able to unlock hidden properties in many arcane-disrupting items.
Very well. I will say that this is disappointing, but it is your choice. Farewell.
Ah, you seem eager, but maybe still too young. Come back when you have grown a bit.

Worry not, though, Ogre - we can replace your unclean runes with a newly-discovered mixture of infusions, eliminating your dependence on them.  The process will feel...  unpleasant, and will dramatically shorten your lifespan, but you will finally be free from the addictive grip of the arcane!
We'll also reinforce the infusions you've been granted to replace your runes - the newest mixture should give you about five years of your life that the initial mixture took from you.

Very well. Before you start, we will make sure no magic can help you:
- You will not be able to use any spells or magical devices
- Any worn objects that are powered by the arcane will be unequipped
%s
Are you ready, or do you wish to prepare first?

#VIOLET#*You are grabbed by two olive-clad warriors and thrown into a crude arena!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear the voice of the Fighter ring above you.*#WHITE#
%s! Your training begins! I want to see you prove your superiority over the works of magic! Fight!
But wha.. [you notice your first opponent is already there]

You are crushed by the collapsing tunnel! You suffocate!
It's a large black ant with huge mandibles.
It's a large red ant, wreathed in flames.
It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.
It's a large yellow ant with sparks arcing across its body.
It's a large black ant.  Its porous skin oozes acid.
It's a large ant with a heavy exoskeleton, geared for war.
Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.aqua: A snake-like being, moving toward you.
A huge, elongated sea-green reptile, it looks old and impenetrable.
Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to lock you down.
Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to blind you with its murky ink.
A small water demon, lobbing spells at you.
Walrog, the lord of Water, is fearsome to behold. The water writhes around him as if trying to escape, making his form indistinct. He does not seem surprised to see you.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.bear: The weakest of bears, covered in brown shaggy fur.
Do you smell like honey? 'Cause this bear wants honey.
It has come down from its cave foraging for food. Unfortunately, it found you.
Bears with tusks, trained to kill.
A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.
This huge white bear has wandered south in search of food.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.bird: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.bone: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
game.modules.tome.data.talents.spells.ma: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.

game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.bone: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies, rune-etched and infused with hateful sorceries.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.cani: Larger than a normal wolf, it prowls and snaps at you.
Easily as big as a horse, this wolf menaces you with its claws and fangs.
A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.
It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.cold: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.mult: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.crys: A shining crystal formation charged with magical energies.
A floating orb of magical energy. It shines with a radiant light. They explode upon contact.
A formation of red crystal. It emits bright red, scorching light.
A formation of white crystal. It emits bright white, chilling light.
A formation of black crystal. It absorbs all light around it.
A formation of crimson crystal. It emits a crimson light reminiscent of blood.
A formation of blue crystal. Its light shines like the ocean's waves.
A formation of multi-hued crystal. It shines with all the colors of the rainbow.
A formation of shimmering crystal. Orbs of light circle around it.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.elve: An elven mage, dressed in dark robes.
An elven mage, dressed in crackling blue robes, and smelling of ozone.
An elven cultist, dressed in sickening green robes.
An elven blood mage, dressing in dark, bloodied robes.
An elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
An elven guard, scarred and sullen.
An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.
An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.faer: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.

game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.feli: A large cat with a grey fur matted with black.
A large black cat, slender and muscular.
A truly magnificent beast, with fur striped black and yellow.
This cat is simply enormous, and has fangs with the size and sharpness of short swords.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.fire: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
A mature fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
An old and powerful fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ghos: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself strives to banish it.

It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crumble rock and wither flesh with ease.
It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.
A vengeful, screaming soul given form with the breath of Urh'Rok himself. The vapors of the Fearscape seep from its dimension-bending form, withering and searing.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ghou: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
game.modules.tome.data.talents.undeads.g: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ghou: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
Stench rises from this rotting abomination. Its brow is adorned with gold, and it moves at you with hatred gleaming in its eyes.
A body raised through dark magic.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.gwel: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.horr: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.
A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.
A disfigured humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features dressed in patched-together and rusted mail armor.  It seems to be in command of others, though its mouth is sewn shut.
A giant hairless bat with the face of a Dwarf twisted into a constant scream.  Pustulant sores cover its malformed body, and your heart weakens as it nears.
A large sluglike creature that moves slowly, leaving a trail of acid in its wake.  Its head has strangely humanoid features.
A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.
This putrid mass of rotting flesh shifts and quivers, but shows no signs of intelligence or mobility.
This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.
#VIOLET#As the necrotic abomination is destroyed you see the remaining bones and flesh reassembling in the form of new foes!

The massive ribcage in the middle beats with loud, audible cracks, as many a skeletal hand protrude forth, entwining, fusing, forming long skeletal appendages to support itself, while others crumble and collapse inward. During all this, somehow, it seems they grasp for you.
#VIOLET#As the bone horror is destroyed you see the remaining bones reassembling in the form of new foes!

This pulsing, quivering form is a deep crimson, and appears to be composed entirely of thick, virulent blood. Waves rhythmically ripple across its surface, indicating a still beating heart somewhere in its body.
game.modules.tome.data.zones.sandworm_la: blood
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.horr: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.

A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
#LIGHT_RED#A carrion worm mass has spawned from %s' wounds!
A bulbous humanoid form floats here. Its bald, child-like head is disproportionately large compared to its body, and its skin is pock-marked with nasty red sores.
A shifting form of darkest night that seems to reflect your deepest fears.
A headless, gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach.
#AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
#AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.horr: A small bloodshot eye floats here.
%s is blinded by the loss of all its eyes.
A lanky humanoid shape composed of yellow light.
A lanky four-armed humanoid shape composed of bright golden light.  It's so bright it's hard to look at, and you can feel heat radiating outward from it.
A headless, round creature with stubby legs and arms.  Its body seems to be all teeth.
Blades whirl in the air around this thin, floating figure. The air around it swirls with force, threatening to tear apart anything that approches, if the blades don't do it first.
A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.
A dark shifting shape stalks through the shadows, blending in seamlessly.

A vaguely tentacled yet constantly changing form rests here apparently oblivious to your existence.
With each slow breath it takes reality distorts around it.  Blue twirls into red, green twists into yellow, and the air sings softly before bursting into a myriad of pastel shapes and colors.

A vaguely tentacled yet rapidly changing shape floats here.  With each breath you can feel reality twist, shatter, and break. 
Blue burns into red, green bursts into yellow, and the air crackles and hisses before exploding into a thousand fragments of sharp shapes and colors.
A pinkish bubble floats here, reflecting the world not as it is, but as it would be in that surreal place that exists only in our dreams.
This powerful vortex of ice and lightning somehow gives you the impression of claws, teeth and intense hunger...
You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...

Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.

A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
This is one of Grgglck's tentacles. It looks more vulnerable than the main body.
#AQUAMARINE#With Grgglck's death its tentacle also falls lifeless on the ground!
#AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
game.modules.tome.data.zones.deep_bellow: #AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.horr: This Blade Horror has been infused with intense temporal magic, causing its power to increase dramatically. Rifts in space open around it constantly, summoning and banishing blades before vanishing as quickly as they appear.
Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
#AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges!
#AQUAMARINE#The %s no longer seems to be controlled and clatters to the ground before vanishing into a rift.
#AQUAMARINE#The %s no longer seems to be controlled and clatters to the ground before vanishing into a rift.
This floating weapon shifts and shimmers, time and space warping and bending as it moves. It appears to vibrate, as if it may explode at any moment.
#AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges! It looks unstable...
#LIGHT_BLUE#%s explodes into a huge bubble of air!
This massive stony structure shifts and pulsates, its many long, thin tentacles probing the nearby water for food.
This tiny fish-like creature moves erratically, but is constantly surrounded by others of its kind.
A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
This frothing ball of water rages with an intense heat.
This titanic mass of flesh pulsates and churns as tiny monsters burst from its orifices.
This pitch black form is shrouded in darkness. All you can make out are a pair of deep red eyes, hidden behind a mass of tentacles.
A small pink-skinned humanoid with large bulbous eyes.
A hulking pink-skinned creature with long arms as thick as tree trunks.  It drags its knuckles on the ground as it lumbers toward you.
A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.
A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.
It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.jell: A strange blob on the dungeon floor.
game.modules.tome.data.talents.gifts.sum: A strange blob on the dungeon floor.

A strange white blob on the dungeon floor.
A strange yellow blob on the dungeon floor.
A strange black blob on the dungeon floor.
A strange black blob on the dungeon floor; through it you seem to be able to see other times and places. As you stare you see things moving out of it.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.lich: Only the most powerful spellcasters raised to unlife become liches. Doomed to haunt the world for an eternity, they have grown to hate all that breathes or trespasses on their domain. Unfortunately that includes you.
Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.
An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.

Blacker than the deepest night, this cold cruel form of darkness approaches.  Long ago it laid aside its mortality, but it has not forgotten its power; rather, its malice and hate have bent this undead entity on the destruction of all things living.
The seething, pumping, disembodied blood of a horrendously powerful necromancer. To strike it is to bathe in the rivers of the Fearscape itself.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.losg: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.majo: A monstrous demon, covered in acidic thorns.
Under a shroud of darkness you discern an evil shape.

This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.
This terrible demon is covered in blood, which flows *on* its skin in ever-changing patterns that disturb you simply when looking at it.

You can only guess at the real shape of this demon. Its body is surrounded by a cloud of fiery darkness.
It moves swiftly toward you, casting terrible spells and swinging its weapons at you.
One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.
A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.mino: A small demon, lobbing spells at you.
Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.

A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.
It is a cross between a human and a bull.
game.modules.tome.data.talents.gifts.sum: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.mino: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.mold: A strange growth on the dungeon floor.
A strange grey growth on the dungeon floor.
A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.
A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.
A strange sickly green growth on the dungeon floor.
Steeped in fungal malevolence, this mold refused to die.  How a mold becomes a skeleton, though, is beyond you.  Are those its own bones, or the bones of hapless adventurers?
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.mult: A mature multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
A huge multi-hued drake. It seems to shift color rapidly.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.naga: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.

Though the sharp point of an arrow pointed steadily at your head is of concern, more unnerving is the creature that wields it: a slim and lithe woman from the waist up, but a terrifying giant serpent beneath, her tail stretching for several feet behind her. Her eyes turn cold and ice seems to magically condense on the tip of her barbed arrow. Suddenly it is of concern again.

Such a mix of enchanting beauty and revolting horror you have never before seen combined. Above, a beautiful, ethereal woman, of scant form and entrancing grace. Below, the thick, smooth scales of a snake, its stretched tail gently waving back and forth in the air behind her. The movement is eye-catching and hypnotic, and whilst you watch a mysterious smile plays across her seductive lips.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ogre: A maul-wield ogre. Ready to CRUSH!
A master of combat, she is impatient to test her newfound skills.
This ogre closes in fast on you, arms open for the hug of death.
A towering ogre guard, her skin covered in runes and arcane designs.
game.modules.tome.data.zones.sandworm_la: vermin
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ooze:
It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols.
Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.
It's very slimy and it's oozing.
It's very slimy and it's oozing.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.orc_: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.
An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.
An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
An orc dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in blood-stained robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in putrid robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.
He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.
A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.
A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.
An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.plan: A not-so-strange growth on the dungeon floor.
This flesh-eating plant has grown to enormous proportions and seeks to quell its hunger.
A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.
This harmless little plant makes you all itchy.
As you approach it, you hear a high-pitched buzzing sound.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.ritc:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
game.modules.tome.data.zones.ritch_tunne:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.rode: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
Instead of fur, this rat has crystals growing on its back, which provide extra protection.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.sand: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. It seems quite unhappy about you being in its lair.
A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. This particular sandworm seems to have been bred for one purpose only: the eradication of everything that is non-sandworm, such as... you.
This unholy creature looks like a wingless dragon in shape, but it is sand-colored, making it all the more dangerous for its prey.
The ground shakes as this huge worm burrows towards you, its gigantic mouth just as capable of devouring flesh as stone.
Space and time seem to bend around this huge worm.
This huge worm burrows through the earth using its powerful corrosive saliva.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.shad: Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.shiv: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.skel: A haphazard collection of crumbling bones, with jerky movements that remind you of a child playing with a marionette.  It only has one arm, but that's all it needs to hold a sword.
A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.

Given its condition, you're less inclined to think this skeleton knows proper spells, rather than simply disgorging its magical energy as it breaks down.  This doesn't make it much less dangerous to be around, mind you.

The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.
This skeleton has been imbued with far more magical energy than normal, and serves as a conduit of its master's spellcasting prowess.

It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
This skeleton can fire arrows and nock new ones with blinding speed.  Arcane forces pull its bones with unnatural precision - its arms will never tremble or get tired.

Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.snak: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.
As you approach, the snake coils up and rattles its tail threateningly.
It is a large snake with a hooded face.
It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.
You recoil in fear as you notice this gigantic snake.  It seeks to crush the life out of you.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.snow: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly. Lightning crackles over its body.

A maddened, enraged snow giant that towers over his comrades. You've heard legends mentioning this particular monstrosity; they say that when he's not rampaging around frothing at the mouth, he sits, almost childlike, engraving stories and mysterious patterns on any flat stone surface he can find.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.spid: A huge arachnid, it produces even bigger webs.
A huge arachnid, it sprays venom at its prey.
A huge arachnid with a massive exoskeleton.
These cunning spiders terrorize those who enter the ever-growing borders of their lairs.  Those who encounter them rarely return.
The air reeks with noxious fumes and the ground around it decays.
This spider seems to command the flow of mana, which pulses freely through its body.
Largest of all the spiderkin, its folds of skin seem nearly impenetrable.
The air seems to freeze solid around this frigid spider.
A tiny arachnid that phases in and out of reality.
A large blue arachnid with white markings on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
A large dark blue arachnid with a shifting yellow and white pattern on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
A huge blue and white spiderkin whose form shifts and shimmers in and out of reality.  She spins the threads of fate and binds the destiny of all within her web.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.stor: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.sunw: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.

game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.swar: A swarm of midges; they want blood.
They buzz at you threateningly, as you have gotten too close to their hive.
You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger dripping venom.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.telu: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.
A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.

game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.thie: The lowest of the thieves, this cutpurse is just learning the tricks of the trade.
Stronger than a cutpurse, this thief has been promoted.
He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?
These ruffians often employ brute force over thievery, but they are capable of stealing as well.
He is the leader of a gang of bandits. Watch out for his underlings.
Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.
Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.thie: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.trol: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.
This old-looking troll glares at you with malice. His muscles appear atrophied, but a certain power surrounds him nonetheless.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.unde: A skeletal rat, teeth and claws ground to a sharp point. It glares at you menacingly.
Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
Looks much like a normal rat. That is, other than the very large fangs.
This massive beast appears to be a rat composed of countless bones fused together.
The master of the pit is before you. It squeaks with menace as it and a horde of minions approach you.
#RED#Rising again, the Rat Lich's eyes glow with renewed energy!
The Rat Lich's true power has been unveiled! Swirling with arcane energy, it stalks towards you uttering warsqueaks at its minions!
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.vamp: These ancient cursed beings often take the form of a bat and attack their prey.
This vampire has only just begun its new life. It has not yet fathomed its newfound power, yet it still has a thirst for blood.
It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.

A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.
It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.veno: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.wild: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.
A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.
game.modules.tome.data.general.npcs.xorn: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
#AQUAMARINE#%s absorbs the energy of the destroyed fragment!
#AQUAMARINE#%s is infused with all the energies of the fragments. The real Harkor'Zun is reconstituted!
A gigantic demon composed of elemental Earth, resembling a twisted Xaren but much, much larger.  It doesn't seem pleased with your presence.

This armour seems to have been patched together from many eels. Yuck.

game.modules.tome.data.general.objects.b: A huge tooth taken from the Mouth, in the Deep Bellow.
These blackened boots have lost all vestiges of any former glory they might have had. Now, they are a testament to the corruption of the Deep Bellow, and its power.

These opalescent orbs stare at you with deathly knowledge, undeceived by your vanities and pretences.  They have lived and died through horrors you could never imagine, and now they lie strung in black chords watching every twitch of the shadows.
If you close your eyes a moment, you can almost imagine what dread sights they see...
a suit of pitted and pocked plate-mail

Inch-thick stralite plates lock together with voratun joints. The whole suit looks impenetrable, but has clearly been subjected to terrible treatment - great dents and misshaping warps, and caustic fissures bored across the surface.
Though clearly a powerful piece, it must once have been much greater.

A filigree of silver set with many small jewels, this diadem seems radiant - ethereal almost. But its touch seems to freeze your skin and brings wild thoughts to your mind. You want to drop it, throw it away, and yet you cannot resist thinking of what powers it might bring you.
Is this temptation a weak will on your part, or some domination from the artifact itself...?

This well-tended sling is made from the leather and sinews of a large hare. It feels smooth to the touch, yet very durable. Some say that the skin of a hare brings luck and fortune.
Hard to tell if that really helped its former owner, but it's clear that the skin is at least also strong and reliable.

A large hairy foot, very recognizably a halfling's, is strung on a piece of thick twine. In its decomposed state it's hard to tell how long ago it parted with its owner, but from what look like teeth marks around the ankle you get the impression that it wasn't given willingly.
It has been kept somewhat intact with layers of salt and clay, but in spite of this it's clear that nature is beginning to take its toll on the dead flesh. Some say the foot of a halfling brings luck to its bearer - right now the only thing you can be sure of is that it stinks.

This pair of fine mesh voratun gauntlets is covered with glyphs of power that spark with azure energy.  The metal is supple and light so as not to interfere with spell-casting.  When and where these gauntlets were forged is a mystery, but odds are the crafter knew a thing or two about magic.
This gorgeous and ornate trident was wielded by Lady Nashva, and when you hold it, you can faintly hear the roar of a rushing river.

This scalpel was used by the dread sorcerer Kor'Pul when he began learning the necromantic arts in the Age of Dusk.  Many were the bodies, living and dead, that became unwilling victims of his terrible experiments.
These dragon scale gloves are tipped with the claws and teeth of a vicious Wyrm. The gloves are warm to the touch.
This ethereal eye stares eternally, as if seeing things that do not truly exist.
A fang from the great warg, Rungof, still covered in blood.

Upon defeat, Ak'Gishil collapsed into this tiny rift. How it remains stable, you are unsure. If you focus, you think you can call forth a sword from it.

Telos was an extremely powerful mage during the Age of Dusk, hated by his peers and feared by the common folk; he was hunted for a long while. He finally fell from his place of power, Telmur, but his spirit still lingers.
